text:
Dara (CS): FYI — onboarding throughput slowdown for some Dedicated and VPC tenants during dedicated-pool warmup after last night's deploy. Affected customers' embedding jobs queuing; onboarding progress stalled. Need embargoed customer note + per-tenant ETA for high-touch list.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-511 created — dedicated pool warmup causing embed job backlog. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-511 Severity: high.

Ethan (SRE): Short summary: an optimization to auto-warm GPU pools changed the batching window, causing long-running batches to queue and block new small jobs. We reverted the tuning at 01:40 UTC and paused new warmups. Requeue of queued small jobs started at 01:52 UTC.

Zara (Eng): Requeue underway. Expect ~60% to finish automatically; ~40% are stuck due to batch checkpoints and need manual resume. Building a targeted resume runner; ETA ~2 hours to process backlog. Will drop runbook + resume tool to /shared/cs/dedicated-warmup-affected.csv and /shared/cs/runbooks/warmup-resume.md.

Dara (CS): Draft short customer-facing blurb for priority outreach: 'We've identified an issue impacting onboarding speed for some Dedicated and VPC customers following a pool warmup change. Engineering has reverted the change and is reprocessing queued embedding jobs. Most customers should see their onboarding make progress within 3 hours. Your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Add suggestions?

Camila (SE): Add safety assurance: 'No model weights or raw customer files were deleted or exposed; this is a processing backlog and checkpoint/state issue.' Also paste this diagnostic for CS: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/jobs?type=embedding
# look for job.state and job.last_checkpoint```

Ravi (CS Manager): Approve comms. For compensation propose: opt-in of either a pro-rated invoice credit for the onboarding billing period OR an extended 2-week trial of Dedicated capacity (whichever the customer prefers). Also schedule office hours tomorrow 8-10am PT for affected customers. Flag renewals with >50% progress delay to GTM and patch in account notes.

Dara (CS): I'll attach the CSV with per-tenant ETAs and send to priority customers in ~10m. Need a short Zendesk canned reply to paste.

Ethan (SRE): Support template uploaded: /shared/cs/templates/dedicated-warmup-incident.txt Suggested snippet: 'We're aware of a slowdown affecting embedding job processing after a pool warmup change. Engineering reverted the change and is reprocessing queued jobs; expected recovery: <ETA>. If your jobs remain queued after <threshold>, please run the diagnostic above and include job ids when opening a ticket.'

Zara (Eng): Confirm no artifacts lost and no data exfiltration. RCA + technical timeline will be posted when reprocessing completes.

Dara (CS): Sending outreach now to high-touch list. Will post final sent copy + list of tenants reached and any opt-ins for credits. Also will capture feedback during office hours and add notes to the CSV. Thanks all :pray:
